normal.source: Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B original text config and fixed operator/state journeys
normal.matrix: BF16 original [6144,2048] physical weights; no free transposition

holdout.source: F2 fixed original norm/projection roles plus ordinary model-free tensor pipeline
holdout.matrix: F2 F32 [4,16384] and [24,16384] physical layouts; dense is a separate ordinary tensor request

input_distribution: shared deterministic finite bytes, original dtype/physical strides/precision; preflight does not expand prior correctness qualification
ownership: caller retains mutable input/output and any requested workspace through true completion; separate cold prepared programs and exclusive invocations
comparison: same exact public math request and user-observable complete overwrite under a caller budget of one; private allocation/packing/checking/runtime costs are charged

cost.cold: context creation, metadata, compile, persistent/slot/workspace allocation recorded separately
cost.hot: Invocation.submit through true Completion.wait, all numeric input copy, cast/packing, managed temporary allocation, checked indices, completion and output write
cost.private_resources: actual prepared facts retained; managed unknown cannot satisfy a strict private-memory contract merely by mathematical equivalence
cost.graph: complete original regions and observable boundaries require separate qualification; these leaf measurements cannot claim their fusion cost

scope: finite four named-provider overlap, not model frequency or full-model inference throughput
limits: unknown hardware/model/software domains use legal mature engineering defaults; no online timing or user provider ranking
